strings.그런데 무슨 일이시죠?: What did you need me for?
The Alliance of Light is making an official request for your help.
strings.빛의 연합에서 직접이요?: Directly from the Alliance of Light?
strings.그래. 이리스 님의 불안정한 상태 때문에 세계의 이곳저곳에 이상 현상이: That's right. You know Iris's unstable condition is causing strange phenomena all over the world?
Then this should be quick to explain.
I don't like to brag, but I've already dealt with two of them.
The incidents in Coral City and the Amaloon Desert...
strings.지엔디아, 이스트랜드…. 그리고 이번엔 프레이오스의 미르간디아 지역인 것: Jiendia, Eastland... And this time, it seems to be the Mirgandia region of Freios. Have you been there? I hear there's a mercenary company...
Yes. I helped them out for a little while.
strings.그렇다면 이 일은 네가 제격이겠군. 그러면 가서 그곳의 담당자에게 이야기: Then you're just the person for this job. Go speak to the person in charge there and proceed from there.
strings.(…담당자라면 파르밀라인가?): (...The person in charge would be Parmila, I suppose?)
Yuran told me you can handle things on your own.
I can, but this is still very little information to go on.
strings.그건 미안하다. 아직 정보가 부족해서 말야. 어쨌든 이리스 님이 루맨에: Sorry about that. We don't know enough yet. In any case, we'll take good care of Iris while she's in Lumen. I hope you'll resolve this for us.
You don't need to make a separate report to me. That is all.
Then I suppose it can't be helped. Please look after Iris.
Good to see you again, Parmila.
strings.그동안 뭘 한다고 코빼기도 안 보인 거야? 여신이라도 잡은 거야?: What have you been doing? I haven't seen hide nor hair of you! Hunting down a goddess or something?
Hunting a goddess...? Hmm. I did fight something similar in a rather strange place.
strings.와아, 어쨌든 잡았구나. 하여튼, 루맨에서 온다던 사람이 %s일 줄은 몰: Wow, so you did! Anyway, I had no idea the person coming from Lumen would be you, %s. That makes this an even nicer surprise!
Haha. Things just worked out that way.
strings.우리 용병단에서도 조사를 하고 싶어도 이미 맡아서 진행 중인 일들이 좀: We wanted to investigate too, but the company already had jobs in progress, so we couldn't.
strings.마침 동방 대륙 '빛의 연합' 사람들이 와서 이상 현상을 본 적이 없냐: Then some people from the Alliance of Light on the eastern continent came and asked whether we'd seen anything unusual.
I told them what was happening here, and they said that matched what they were looking for.
strings.(이리스가 불안정한 상태라서 일어난 이상 현상이라 바로 어떻게 할 수는: (Since the phenomenon was caused by Iris's unstable condition, they probably couldn't do anything about it immediately...)
strings.어, %s. 왔습니까? 그건 그렇고 단장, 집 나간 고양이를 찾아달란 의: Oh, %s. You're here. More to the point, Captain, how many missing-cat requests do we have?
The people of Drulridge would be much better at finding animals...
There are six cats left. I'm counting on you, Cal-lone.
strings.(칼로네가 영혼이 나간 것 같은 표정으로 사라진다.): (Callone leaves with a look of utter spiritual defeat.)
Finding runaway cats seems to be your main line of work.
Hehehe. You know us. We're a mercenary company—anything that pays!
Shall we get to the point now?
strings.아하하하, 미안. 그럼 그 산에 관해 이야기할게. 비취수림 건너에 괴물들: Ahahaha, sorry. Let me tell you about the mountain. Beyond Jade Forest, there's a sinister-looking mountain that seems to be crawling with monsters.
strings.사람들은 그곳을 '괴물나무 산'이라 부르고 좀처럼 가지 않아. 가까운 곳: People call it 'Monster Tree Mountain,' and hardly anyone goes there. It's nearby, but the terrain is so rough that even our company hasn't visited.
strings.그런데 얼마 전부터 말야. 이상한 소리가 들려오기 시작했어. 짐승의 것도: But lately, we've started hearing strange sounds. A monster's cry—neither human nor animal.
strings.산과 숲에 있던 동물들이 동요해서 이 근처까지 내려와서 엄청 소란스러웠지: The animals in the mountains and forest panicked and came down this way. It caused a huge commotion. The people of Drulridge calmed them and took them away, but...
strings.여기 뒤에 묘지 보이지? 드룰리지 사람들이 죽은 자들의 기운이 느껴진다고: See the graveyard behind us? The people of Drulridge told us to be careful because they could sense the presence of the dead. We're looking into it.
strings.미르간디아 지역 사람들이 모두 불안에 떨고 있어. 우린 우리대로 조사를: Everyone in Mirgandia is frightened. We're conducting our own investigation, so could you visit Monster Tree Mountain?
strings.이상하게 생긴 거대 바위가 있다는 이야기도 들었는데…. 혹시 모르니 그것: I've also heard there's an enormous, oddly shaped boulder there... You might as well check that out too. This sort of thing seems right up your alley.
All right. I'll head there now.
strings.음마, 깜짝이여!!: Well, I'll be! You startled me!
Shh! Keep it down. You'll set that thing howling again.
Y-yes...? I've never seen a talking boulder before.
strings.내는 정령이여, 이름은 라피뎀이라고 하는구먼. 그런데 자넨 누구여?: I'm a spirit, you know. Name's Lapidem. And who might you be?
strings.(라피뎀에게 여기까지 오게 된 상황을 설명한다.): (You explain to Lapidem what brought you here.)
strings.그러니께 자네가 새로운 여신의 일을 한단겨? 그리고 소리 지르는 갸를 알: So you're doing work for the new goddess? And you've come to look into the thing doing all that shouting?
strings.맞아요, 라피뎀. 이 괴물나무 산속에 소리 지르는 괴물이 있다고 해서 왔: That's right, Lapidem. I came because I heard there's a monster screaming inside Monster Tree Mountain.
strings.흐음, 확실히 자네는 보통 인물이 아닌 것 같구먼. 여기까지 오면 내 알: Hmm. You're certainly no ordinary sort. I ought to have noticed you coming this far, but I didn't sense a thing.
Still, I see humans are calling this place 'monstrous' even now.
strings.사실 이곳이 일반적이진 않어. 가이아 여신께서 좀 더 신경 써서 다른 곳: Truth be told, it isn't an ordinary place. Goddess Gaia gave it a little extra attention, so it's different from elsewhere, that's all.
strings.사람들 보기에 무섭게 생기고 못 생겨보이는 모습들이 있긴 혀. 그게 나쁜: Some things here might look frightening or ugly to human eyes. But that doesn't make them bad. It's no crime, is it?
Right? It's no crime in your case either.
strings.네, 저도 죄는 아니지만…. 네, 네?: Yes, it's no crime for me either... Wait, what?
strings.자네 말여. 내 부탁 하나만 들어주겄나?: Say, would you do me a favor?
strings.초면에 미안혀. 내 몸이 이려서 맛이 간 아그들을 혼내줄 수 없구먼. 자: Sorry to ask when we've just met. With a body like this, I can't knock sense into the little ones who've gone mad. Could you deal with the ones causing trouble nearby?
strings.아마 갸들이 아르보룸 때문에 정신이 살짝 나갔을껴. 그러니 돌아오게만 해: I reckon Arborum's made them lose their minds a bit. Just bring them back to their senses, all right?
All right. I'll give them a little talking-to.
The little ones have come to their senses. Good work.
It's nothing. It was something I could do.
strings.아르보룸 금마를 어떻게 처리할지 고민이여. 내가 여신님을 보필하던 그때였: I've been wondering how to handle that Arborum. Back when I served the goddess, I could've sorted it out without breaking a sweat.
strings.혹시 마왕과 싸우던 땐가요?: Do you mean when you fought the Demon King?
strings.맞구먼. 여러 신님이 싸우다 소멸하고, 이스트랜드에 떨어지고 그랬재. 나: That's right. Gods perished in the fighting and fell onto Eastland. When I landed here, I nearly died myself.
strings.가이아 여신께서 신성한 바위와 하나가 되도록 해주셔서 소멸하지 않고 살수: Goddess Gaia joined me to a sacred boulder. That's how I survived instead of fading away.
strings.여신께서 미안하다고 하시는 모습이 아직도 선명혀. 그러고 보니 깨어나실: I still remember her apologizing, plain as day. Come to think of it, it's about time she woke up...
Will she go straight to the Land of Illusions when she wakes, I wonder...?
strings.으휴, 내가 돌댕이가 돼부려서 어디 가지도 못하고 답답혀. 그래도 내 이: Ah, being a lump of rock is stifling. Can't go anywhere. Still, I've watched over this mountain for a long time.
strings.저기…, 옛날이야기 말고 현재 괴물나무 산의 이야기를 좀 해주실 수 없을: Um... Could you tell me what's happening on Monster Tree Mountain now, rather than what happened ages ago?
strings.미안혀. 이렇게 된 게 내 잘못이라 말하기도 애매하구먼. 그리고 우리 아: Sorry. It's hard to talk about, since it's my fault things ended up like this. Besides, we haven't enough 'trust' between us yet...
So I'd like you to show me something to build up that trust a little more.
strings.맛있는 음식이라도 들고 올까요? 아니면 무슨 일을 더 해야 하나요?: Should I bring you something tasty? Or is there another job I need to do?
strings.난 음식은 안 먹으니께…. 아, 그라믄 자네를 알고 있는 정령들에게 신뢰: I don't eat food... Ah, I know. Get a Mark of Trust from the spirits who know you.
strings.내 요즘 어린 정령들은 모르겄지만, 나같이 늙은 정령들은 '신뢰'를 보여: I don't know about young spirits these days, but old ones like me need something that shows 'trust.' Evidence, you might say...
The goddess made us this way, so there's no helping it. Sorry about that.
All right. Where should I go, then...? Back to the inner world, perhaps...
strings.오늘은 무슨 일로 심상세계에 오셨나요?: What brings you to the inner world today?
(You tell Harmonia about meeting Lapidem, the rock spirit on Monster Tree Mountain.)
strings.라피뎀 님께서 어려운 일을 맞이하셨군요. 저는 모험가님을 신뢰하지만, 제: So Lord Lapidem is facing a difficult situation. I trust you, adventurer, but I don't know whether the extent of my trust would meet his standards.
strings.하르모니아는 조화와 안정의 정령왕이잖아요. 그럼 기아스는요?: But you're the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability. What about Geis?
Geis is in much the same position as I am.
strings.그래도 그 기준에 맞는 적임자가 있답니다. 모험가님도 알고 라피뎀 님도: But there is someone who would meet those standards. Someone both you and Lord Lapidem know well...
Yes, exactly. That child should be able to help you.
strings.그러고보니 미르에게 좋은 걸 많이 주셨다면서요?: Come to think of it, I hear you've been giving Mir all sorts of nice things.
strings.그 아이를 아껴주셔서 감사드려요. 미르가 기다리고 있을 테니 어서 가보세: Thank you for being so kind to Mir. The child will be waiting for you, so please go ahead.
strings.심상세계엔 또 무슨 일이세요? 아니면 저한테 육포라도 주려고 오셨나요?: What brings you to the inner world again? Or have you come to give me more jerky? Hehe...
strings.일단 육포를 주고 시작할 테니, 제가 이야기하는 거 들어줘야 해요. 알았: I'll give you the jerky first, but then you have to listen to me. All right?
strings.(미르에게 괴물나무 산의 라피뎀에 대한 이야기를 한다.): (You tell Mir about Lapidem on Monster Tree Mountain.)
strings.라피뎀 영감님이 이렇게 육포를 제공해주신다는 훌륭한 모험가님을 신뢰할 수: Old Lapidem doesn't trust such a wonderful adventurer, who supplies me with all this jerky? That's ridiculous!
I'm starting to think I can't trust you, Mir...
strings.(미르가 %s의 어깨에 잠시 손을 올려놓는다.): (Mir rests a hand on %s's shoulder for a moment.)
strings.이 정도면 됐을 거예요. 저는 위대한 플루톤 드래곤의 후예니까 이 정도는: That should do it. I'm a descendant of the great Pluton Dragon, so this is as easy as eating warm jerky.
strings.왜 다 육포 먹는 거로 표현하는 거죠?: Why do you describe everything in terms of eating jerky?
strings.그야 맛있으니까요!! 혹시 더 맛있는 게 있다면 다음에 가져다주세요!: Because it's delicious! If you find anything even tastier, bring it next time!
strings.(안 그래도 주머니에서 육포를 꺼내 먹던 중이었구나.): (So Mir was already pulling jerky out of a pocket and eating it.)
strings.신뢰의 각인을 남겼으니 라피뎀 영감님께 가서 보여주세요. 그러면 인정해: I've left the Mark of Trust. Go show it to old Lapidem. Then he'll acknowledge you.
strings.고마워요, 미르. 궁금한 게 있는데, 라피뎀 님하고는 어떻게 알게 됐어요: Thanks, Mir. I'm curious—how did you meet Lapidem?
strings.가이아 여신님께서 깨어나실 때, 제가 메시지를 받아 전달해드렸거든요. 그: When Goddess Gaia wakes, I receive her messages and deliver them. Come to think of it, it's about time she woke up...
I'd like to meet her someday, if I have the chance. I'll be going, then. Thank you.
strings.뭘요. 육포 감사드려요!! 다음에도 부탁드려요!!: It's nothing. Thanks for the jerky! Bring more next time!
strings.산 초입부터 용인지 정령인지 구분 안 되던 아가의 신뢰가 가득 느껴졌구먼: I could feel that little one's trust in you from the foot of the mountain. Never could tell whether the child was a dragon or a spirit. But tell me, how did you earn that trust? Ah, did you offer food?
Yes. Lots of jerky from Lumen...
strings.갸가 몇 년 전부터 가이아님의 메시지를 전달하러 오는데, 그때마다 산의: That child started bringing me Goddess Gaia's messages a few years ago. Every visit, the mountain ran out of food.
strings.수천 년 동안 그런 일이 처음이라…. 뱃속에 그지 프리링이 들었는지 슈크: Never seen anything like it in thousands of years... The Shukris and Mountain Ogres were beside themselves with no food left. You'd think there was a starving Priring in that belly.
strings.하아…, 그렇군요. 그러면 이제 약속대로 이 산의 이야길 제대로 해주실: Sigh... I see. Then, as promised, could you tell me what's really happening on this mountain?
I'll try to solve the problem. Iris's work is my work, too.
strings.알겄어. 내 이제 자넬 이리스 여신님의 심부름꾼으로 제대로 인정할 테니: All right. I officially recognize you as Goddess Iris's errand-runner. I'd be grateful for your help.
strings.얼마 전 일이었재. 내가 수 천 년 동안 잠든 적이 없었는데 말여. 순식: It happened a little while ago. I hadn't slept in thousands of years, but all of a sudden, I nodded off.
Only for an instant. An instant! About as long as it takes an ant to move one step.
strings.그 사이에 이상한 기운이 산에 맴돌더니 짠~하고 내려온 겨. 산에 있던: In that instant, a strange energy drifted around the mountain, then came down just like that! Rocks, rotten branches, and bits of rubbish gathered together and turned into that thing.
strings.이름이 왜 '아르보룸'인지는 몰랐지만, 그놈의 울음소리를 듣는 순간 떡허: I didn't know why it was called 'Arborum,' but the moment I heard its cry, I understood something clear as day.
strings.이곳의 존재가 아닌 다른 차원의 틈에서 흘러들어온 힘으로 만들어졌다는 걸: It was made from power that had seeped through a rift from another dimension. Not power from this place.
strings.그렇군요. 그 힘…. 혹시 이리스와 관계가 있을까요?: I see. That power... Could it be connected to Iris?
strings.자세한 건 모르겄지만, 여신님을 노리고 있는 존재가 마계 놈들 말고 또: I don't know the details, but it means the creatures of the Demon Realm aren't the only ones after the goddess.
strings.아가슈라 일족과 마계의 군주들, 그리고 다른 세계의 존재. 내가 확실하게: The Agasura clan, the lords of the Demon Realm, and a being from another world. What I can tell you for certain is... Urgh...
strings.으윽. 아르보룸 놈이 또 시끄럽게 울어대서 돌댕이인 내도 다 괴로울 정도: Urgh. That Arborum's howling again. It's so loud that even a rock like me can't stand it. And I think it's devoured the mountain's spiritual energy.
But why are you perfectly fine? Hardly seems fair...
strings.그런 건 신경 쓰지 말고 정신 차리세요!! 제가 그 괴물을 손 보고 올게: Forget about that and stay with me! I'll go deal with the monster.
strings.내 자네가 다녀올 때까지 정신 차릴테니 그 놈을 꼭 잡아야 혀. 부턱허네: I'll hold on until you get back. Make sure you beat that thing. I'm counting on you!
strings.아, 가는 길에 못된 짓 하는 녀석들도 좀 같이 혼내주고. 알았재?: Oh, and give the troublemakers along the way a telling-off too. All right?
Ahh. At last, it feels like the mountain's spiritual energy is returning...
I'm back. Arborum certainly wasn't an easy opponent.
strings.고맙구먼. 찌뿌둥한 피로가 싹 가시는 기분이여! 내 잊지 않을겨!: Thank you. Feels like all that lingering weariness has vanished! I won't forget this!
strings.그런데 다 끝난 게 아니구먼. 아르보룸이 사라지긴 했어도, 그 놈이 만든: But it's not all over. Arborum may be gone, but it's left plenty of trouble behind.
strings.잠깐…. 남아있다면 어디가… 아, 묘지!: Wait... If there's more, where would it... Oh, the graveyard!
strings.묘지는 무슨 말인겨? 바보 인간들이 잔뜩 모인 성 인근 그곳 말이여?: What graveyard? The one near the castle where all those foolish humans gather?
strings.(바보 인간들이면 용병단이군.): (By foolish humans, he must mean the mercenaries.)
strings.아마도 그쪽 같아요. 그곳에 죽은 자들이 깨어난 걸 본 것 같다 그랬거든: That's probably the place. They said they thought the dead were waking there.
Oh, right. There's something I haven't told you...
strings.한참 뒤에 시간 나면 말여, 내한티 좀 오겄나?: When you have some free time later on, would you come see me?
There's something I want to say. It's nothing urgent, so take your time thinking about it.
strings.일단 바보 인간들에게 뭔 일이 생겼나 보고 와. 어떤지 보고 이야기 해줄: For now, go see what's happened to those foolish humans. Find out how things stand, and we'll talk.
All right. I'll go take a look.
strings.생각보다 심각해. 이제 괴물의 울음소리가 들려오지 않아서 다행이라 생각했: It's worse than I thought. I was relieved that the monster's cries had stopped, but now the dead have risen from the graveyard.
strings.괴물나무 산에서 비명이 들려오더니 갑자기 무덤이 갈라지더니 그 속에서 해: A scream came from Monster Tree Mountain, and then the graves suddenly split open. Skeletal mages and knights climbed out!
Mages and knights turned into undead monsters...
A monster that appeared out of nowhere, and ghosts awakened by its cries...
We knock them down, and they just get back up. Over and over. What a mess.
strings.%s, 우리가 어떻게든 막아내고 있을테니 방법을 알아왔으면 좋겠어. 부탁: %s, we'll hold them back somehow. Please find a way to stop this. I'm counting on you.
strings.서두를게요. 좀 버텨요!! 알았죠?: I'll hurry. Hang in there! All right?
strings.후후, 우리 용병단을 우습게 보지 마!! 아케인, 가서 실력을 보여주자고: Hehe, don't underestimate our company! Arcane, let's show them what we can do!
strings.좋지, 단장! 몸통 박치기!!: You got it, Captain! Body Slam!
Sigh... No choice. I don't like it, but I'll have to use those techniques...
The dead have risen in the graveyard and are coming out.
strings.그전까지는 깨어났어도 나가진 않았을 거여. 드루이드들이 억울하게 죽은 왕: Before this, even if they woke up, they wouldn't have left. The druids' prayers for the unjustly slain king, his knights, and his mages had formed a barrier.
strings.몇백 년 전, 벨키아 왕국의 국왕 레툼은 자국 국민에겐 성군이나 다름없는: Several hundred years ago, King Letum of Belkia was practically a saint to his own people.
strings.하지만 구 제국과 실바리아 왕국, 기타 세력에는 작은 약소국일 수밖에 없: But compared to the old Empire, the Kingdom of Silvaria, and the other powers, his was just a small, weak kingdom.
So he decided to do something: conquer the Mirgandia region.
strings.고대신들이 머물렀던 과거 때문에 말여. 다른 곳보다 마력과 자원이 충만한: The ancient gods once stayed there, you see. Mirgandia had more magic and resources than anywhere else. If Belkia took it, the kingdom could have prospered. But...
strings.미르간디아 지방은 오랫동안 드루이드들이 살았는데, 이들은 다른 왕국과 기: The druids had lived in Mirgandia for ages. They didn't welcome foreign kingdoms and knights. Their calling was to keep nature just as it was.
strings.그래서 오랫동안 벨키아 왕국군과 드루이드들이 싸웠는데, 먼저 그만둔 건: So Belkia's army and the druids fought for a long time. In the end, the Belkians were the first to stop.
strings.아마도 레툼이 아니다 생각하고 돌아간 것 같은데 말여. 자네도 알지 모르: I reckon Letum realized it was wrong and turned back. But a fellow you might know—Nepandus—killed every last one of them.
strings.거기에 저주까지 심어서 그들을 언데드로 만들었구먼. 네판 뭐시기는 참 지: Then he laid a curse on them and made them undead. That Nepan-whatever was a nasty piece of work. Thankfully, the druids prayed for their souls to find peace.
strings.아르보룸의 괴성이 결계를 깨버린게 됐으니 죽음에서 돌아온 그들이 뭘 허겠: But Arborum's shriek broke the barrier. What do you think those returned dead will do now? They'll try to kill everything they see.
I've fought Nepandus before, when he came back as a lich. I defeated him.
strings.그려? 그게 자네였구먼. 잘 혔어. 어쩐지 그 더러운 기운이 확 생겼다가: Really? So that was you. Well done. I did wonder why that filthy presence suddenly appeared, then vanished.
This won't be easy either, will it?
Even the goddess's errand-runner will have trouble dealing with the dead.
strings.지금까진 잘 했어도, 이번엔 다를 테니께. 그래서 내가 도움을 줄겨. 힘: You've done well so far, but this will be different. So I'll help. I'll lend you my power!
strings.이 힘은 말여. 죽은 생명이 안식을 취할 수 있게 돕는 힘이여. 내가 오: This power helps dead creatures find rest. I've been doing that a long time. If those fellows came before me, I'd lay the lot of them to rest...
strings.아차차, 말이 길었구먼. 자, 눈을 감어. 중간에 뜨지 말고. 알았재?: Oops, there I go rambling again. Now close your eyes. Don't open them halfway through, all right?
strings.(눈을 감자 괴물나무 산의 정기가 온몸에 느껴진다. 마치 세상의 자연을: (As you close your eyes, the spiritual energy of Monster Tree Mountain fills your body. You feel lighter, as though you hold all the world's nature within you.)
strings.일시적이긴 하지만, 그놈들을 흙으로 돌리는 데 도움이 될 거여. 뭐 혀?: It's only temporary, but it should help you return them to the earth. What are you waiting for? Get moving!
strings.(갑자기 라피뎀의 앞에 어떤 여성의 모습이 희미하게 나타난다.): (A woman's faint image suddenly appears before Lapidem.)
strings.어라? 설마 이리스 여신님인가유?: Oh? Could that be Goddess Iris?
It's a pleasure to meet you, Lapidem. And thank you for your help.
strings.아녀유. 제가 할 일이구먼유. 아, 심부름꾼헌티 말하지 않은 게 하나 있: Not at all, Your Grace. It's my duty. Ah, there's something I didn't tell your errand-runner. Is that all right? About the 'sinner,' I mean.
I didn't think it was my place to speak about that.
strings.네, 잘하셨어요. 아직 그분이 아셔선 안 될 것 같아요. 저도 파악 중이: Yes, you did the right thing. I don't think they should know yet. I'm still trying to understand it myself.
If that's your wish, Goddess, I'll keep my mouth shut tight as a rock.
Thank you. I hope next time we can meet under better—
strings.(말을 이어가던 이리스의 모습이 그대로 굳었다.): (Iris's image freezes in the middle of her sentence.)
strings.(이리스의 모습이 그대로 굳은 채 라피뎀의 시야에서 사라진다.): (Still frozen, Iris's image disappears from Lapidem's sight.)
strings.여신님도 아직 익숙허시지 않구먼. 그나저나 여신님 말씀이니께 조용히 있긴: Seems the goddess hasn't quite got the hang of it yet. Well, I'll keep quiet since she asked, but something about it doesn't sit right...
My Body Slam isn't working... These things really are something.
strings.단장, 그런 스킬 같은 건 없다고!!: Captain, he doesn't have a skill like that!
strings.어, 왔군요. 정말 피곤합니다. 이들의 실력은 확실합니다만, 가끔 한심함: Oh, you're back. Exhausting, frankly. Those two are certainly skilled, but sometimes their foolishness makes me want to scream.
Yes, I think I get the picture.
strings.후아…. 숫자가 너무 많아. 벨키아 왕국군이 대체 여기에 얼마나 있었던: Whew... There are too many. How many Belkian soldiers were here, anyway...?
strings.방법이 있어? 정말 있는 거야? 죽은 존재를 제대로 상대하는 방법이?!: You found a way? Really? A way to deal with the dead properly?!
strings.(괴물나무 산에 있는 정령에게 도움을 받았다고 했다.): (You explain that the spirit on Monster Tree Mountain has helped you.)
You really are amazing. Working for a goddess, getting help from spirits...
strings.지금 뭐 해? 빨리 가서 해결해야지! 죽은 존재를 상대하는 건 썩 기분: What are you standing around for? Hurry up and deal with them! Fighting dead people isn't exactly pleasant!
strings.알았어요. 그럼 다녀올게요. 제가 다녀오는 동안 이곳으로 빠져나오는 존재: All right. I'm going. While I'm inside, if any of them escape this way, force them back in as best you can. Understood?
Got it. Leave it to me.
strings.(파르밀라가 전사들의 쉼터로 들어가는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Parmila watches %s intently as they enter the Warriors' Rest.)
Captain. You look like you have something to say.
strings.혹시 말야. %s 말인데, %s 정보도 제국 마법 연구소에 있을까?: About %s... Do you think the Imperial Magic Research Institute has information on %s, too?
They should have records on every famous or unusual individual.
strings.%s…, 이 사람은 카이나 여제가 지켜보고 계실테니 불경한 자들이 쉽게: %s... Empress Kaina is watching over this person. Those impious people won't be able to lay a hand on them easily.
Worry about that later. For now, we should focus on the task at hand.
strings.칼로네가 오랜만에 마음에 드는 이야길 하네. 후후. 그럼 가볼까?: For once, Callone says something I like. Hehe. Shall we get going?
I wasn't saying it to please you... Heh.
strings.단장, 단장. 제 이야기 듣고 있습니까?: Captain. Captain, are you listening to me?
The knights aren't moving anymore... That means...
Just as I'd expect from %s... You took care of everything.
Yes. It wasn't easy. That's the third strange phenomenon dealt with...
strings.잠깐, 그 이상 현상이란 거 말야. 계속해서 일어나는 거야?: Wait. These strange phenomena—are they going to keep happening?
strings.아마도 당분간 계속 일어나지 않을까요?: They probably will for a while, won't they?
strings.그거 예전에 계속해서 찾았던 그 사람과 관련된 일인 거야?: Does it have something to do with that person you were searching for all that time?
strings.…이리스와 관련된 일이긴 하지만, 이리스 잘못은 아니에요. 정확히 말씀드: ...It is connected to Iris, but it isn't her fault. It's hard to explain exactly. Please just understand that much.
strings.후후, 알겠어. 앞으로도 당신이 계속해서 잘 해결할 것 같으니까 신경 쓰: Hehe. All right. You seem likely to keep sorting things out, so I won't worry.
strings.그래도 우리 용병단 일까지 가로채면 안 돼. 알았지?: Just don't start stealing our company's jobs too. Got it?
Don't worry. I doubt our work will overlap.
Now, what else did we have to do...?
strings.미르간디아 지역을 확실히 조사할 필요가 있습니다. 무슨 일이 어떻게 일어: We need a thorough survey of the Mirgandia region. No one knows what might happen next, or how.
Ugh, I don't care. I'm tired. I want a break.
strings.단장! 제 이야기 듣고 있습니까?!: Captain! Are you listening to me?!
strings.장난이야. 장난. 일단 벨키아 왕국군 아저씨들 명복부터 빌어주자고. 그러: I'm kidding. Kidding! First, let's pray for those Belkian soldiers to rest in peace. We'll need to call in the druids for that, right?
strings.아, %s…. 가서 그 정령한테 고맙다고 전해줘. 내가 가고 싶긴 하지만: Oh, %s... Tell that spirit I said thank you. I'd like to go myself, but it feels as though I'd be intruding on their territory. I'm sorry. And thank you.
It's nothing. I'm just glad it ended well.
strings.아, 지금 생각난 건데 부탁하고 싶은 일이 있어. 급한 건 아니고 시간날: Oh, I just remembered something I'd like your help with. It's not urgent. Come see me when you have time, and I'll tell you about it.
I'll be going, then. See you later, Parmila.
Take care. Whew... Now I can rest a little.
I was going to say goodbye, but they're gone already.
strings.우리 돈이 급하니 고양이부터 찾으러 가지 않겠어?: We're short on money. Why don't you go find those cats first?
strings.으, 알겠습니다. 그런데 단장, 며칠 전에 제국으로부터 입금이 됐다고 알: Ugh, all right. But Captain, I'm fairly sure a payment came in from the Empire a few days ago...
strings.아하하하하하, 몰라. 나도 몰라. 그러니 고양이부터 찾고 보자고. 아하하: Ahahahahaha! No idea. I don't know anything. Let's just find the cats first. Ahahahahaha! Can't hear you!
Captain! Captain, are you listening to me? Sigh...
The power you gave me seems to have vanished the moment I defeated King Letum.
Good work. If that's how it went, then all's well.
Thank you. I'd better get going now. I still have things left to do...
strings.그려그려. 가끔 놀러 오고. 맛있는 음식들이 있으니께 생각나면 와서 배터: Of course, of course. Come visit now and then. There's plenty of good food here. Drop by when you feel like it and eat your fill, all right?
strings.금마만치 무리해서 먹을 건 아니재?: You won't eat as much as that little one, will you?
strings.에이, 그 정도는 못 먹어요. 가끔 와서 도울 테니까 옛날이야기나 들려주: No, I couldn't possibly. I'll come help from time to time, so tell me some stories about the old days.
Agreed. Travel safely, then. I can't move this body, so I won't be seeing you out.
strings.그건 그렇고 자네 말여. 혹시 기억을 잃은 적이 있나? 표정이 딱 그런: By the way... Have you ever lost your memory? That's the sort of look you have.
Huh? No. Everyone I've met lately keeps asking me that.
strings.내가 자네에게 도움을 줄 수 있을지도 모르겠구먼. 관심이 있으면 나중에: I may be able to help you. If you're interested, would you hear me out sometime?
I'm not forcing you. Just drop by when you have a moment.
Don't doze off like you did this time. Take care, all right? I'll be back.
strings.이 불길한 냄새는 분명 아가슈라…. 진한 걸 보니 사납기 그지없는 녀석이: That sinister smell is definitely an Agasura... So strong. A vicious one, by the scent of it.
strings.이제 나오는 건 어뗘, 제릴?: Why don't you come out now, Jeril?
strings.(라피뎀이 이름을 부르자 앳된 모습의 소년이 천천히 걸어온다.): (When Lapidem calls his name, a youthful-looking boy walks slowly toward him.)
As foul a beast as ever.
It's been a while, old man. But I'm not the foul one. Your temper is.
I don't want you calling me old man. You're getting on in years yourself... What wickedness brings you here after hundreds of years, anyway?
strings.영감, 날 몰라서 하는 말이야?: Old man, don't you know me better than that?
I know you're different from those half-baked Agasuras.
strings.후후, 내가 확인하고 싶은 게 있어서 말이야. 여신과 이야기하던 '죄인': Hehe. There's something I want to check. What's this 'sinner' you were discussing with the goddess? I came to ask about something else, but...
strings.어디까지 들은겨? 그리고 묻고 싶은 건 또 뭐여?: How much did you hear? And what did you want to ask?
strings.영감은 뭔가 알고 있군. 슬쩍 떠본 건데, 많이 당황했군. 후후, 의외의: So you do know something. I was only testing the waters, but that really rattled you. Hehe. An unexpected find.
strings.난 몰러. 모르니께 그만 하는게 좋겠구먼. 나도 알고 있는게 별로 없어서: I don't know. Best leave it alone. I don't know much about it myself.
strings.세계의 지혜를 모두 품고 있는 정령이 모르는 게 있을리가. 됐어. 영감: A spirit holding all the world's wisdom, not knowing something? Never mind. Your reaction was enough. Now I'll just wait.
strings.그나저나 내가 영감을 어떻게 했으면 좋겠어? 신께서 목숨을 구원해주신 정: Still, what should I do with you, old man? I can't kill a spirit whose life a god saved...
strings.뭐여? 뭔 짓을 하려고?: What? What are you planning to do?
strings.선물을 하나 주지. 내가 여기 왔다는 것쯤은 금방 잊게 해줄 수 있는 작: I'll give you a present. A little dream that will soon make you forget I was ever here.
strings.(제릴이 미소를 짓자 라피뎀이 죽은 것처럼 움직임을 멈췄다.): (As Jeril smiles, Lapidem stops moving as though dead.)
strings.영감 덕분에 죄인이 '아▒▒엘'과 관련된 것도 다 알게 되고 아주 만족스: Thanks to you, old man, I even learned that the sinner is connected to 'A▒▒el.' I'm quite satisfied.
This was fun, old man. Take care.
strings.(한참 뒤에야 라피뎀이 다시 정신을 차린다.): (Only after a long while does Lapidem regain consciousness.)
strings.기분이 이상한데…? 누가 왔다 간겨? 내가 또 잠들었나? 그런 건 아닌데: I feel strange... Did someone come by? Did I fall asleep again? Doesn't seem like it...
Bah, I don't know. Shall I call the little ones and see how they're doing?
